items.problem: First build of the migrated project failed with 12x 'error CS0579: Duplicate '...Attribute' attribute' from the copied UWP Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs colliding with the SDK-style project's auto-generated assembly attributes.
items.evidence: lessons.json errors_encountered / skill-defects.json item 1; build-events.jsonl ~L784-806 ('duplicate assembly attributes from ...\Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs' -> 'Fix by adding <GenerateAssemblyInfo>false</GenerateAssemblyInfo>'); build-output.txt shows GenerateAssemblyInfo=false in the final csproj.
items.root_cause: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 copies every legacy .cs (incl. Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs); SDK-style (Microsoft.NET.Sdk) projects default GenerateAssemblyInfo=true and emit the same assembly attributes, so each is declared twice -> CS0579.
items.change: In Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 copy filter, exclude any file named 'AssemblyInfo.cs' from the copied build sources (new $srcExcludeFiles guard), mirroring the existing ILC *.g.cs duplicate-source exclusion. Deterministic; cannot be ignored by the agent.
items.expected_effect: The migrated tree no longer contains a legacy AssemblyInfo.cs, so the SDK's auto-generated assembly attributes are the only copy and CS0579 does not occur.
items.falsifiable_check: On a re-run, `dotnet build` of the migrated project produces zero 'error CS0579: Duplicate ... attribute' diagnostics, and no AssemblyInfo.cs (outside .uwp-source/obj/bin) exists under the target.

items.problem: Same as above — backstop for the rare case where a non-standard AssemblyInfo.cs must be retained, or a legacy file slips in from a manual copy.
items.evidence: skill-defects.json item 1: grep of the whole skill for AssemblyInfo/GenerateAssemblyInfo/CS0579 returned 0 matches — the 'Common build errors' section documents CS0104/CS0227/CS0101/CS0246 but not CS0579.
items.root_cause: No documented root cause + fix for CS0579, so an agent hitting it must diagnose from scratch.
items.change: Add a 'CS0579: Duplicate '...Attribute' attribute' subsection to MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md 'Common build errors after the namespace rewrite' explaining the SDK auto-generation clash and giving both fixes (delete the superseded file; or retain it + <GenerateAssemblyInfo>false</GenerateAssemblyInfo> when attributes like InternalsVisibleTo must be kept).
items.expected_effect: If any AssemblyInfo.cs still reaches the build, the agent resolves CS0579 in one step from documented guidance instead of trial-and-error.
items.falsifiable_check: On a re-run where an AssemblyInfo.cs is present, the agent applies the documented delete-or-GenerateAssemblyInfo-false fix and the build reaches 0 CS0579 errors.
